# Changes to Longfellow

<!-- Generated by scripts/longfellow_changes.py from third_party/longfellow/licensing.json; do not edit. -->

Every file below is a Longfellow file we changed (modified, at its upstream path) or a new file copying substantial Longfellow code (derived, with its upstream source). Longfellow is google/longfellow-zk at `d5e6be77`. Files used unchanged live under `third_party/longfellow/`, listed in its `manifest.json` and checked by `scripts/check_vendor.py`.

To print a file's full diff against the pinned upstream:

```sh
git submodule update --init comparisons/longfellow/upstream
python3 scripts/longfellow_changes.py --diff lib/zk/zk_prover.h
```
